title: Gaussian low-Schmidt-rank chaining controls both partial-transpose images

statement.quantifiers: Every complex local dimension d>=1,1<=k<=d,u>=0; centered Hermitian Gaussian G with Var Tr(GZ)<=||Z||F² for every Hermitian Z; r=(4d+1)k.
statement.assertion: Pr{sup_SR(v)<=k,||v||=1 |<v,Gv>|>40sqrt(r)+8sqrt(u)}<=exp(-u). For projected standard Gaussian on zero-both-marginals H0, G^Gamma has the same law, so both supports<=48sqrt(r) with failure<=2exp(-r). For k<=d/2^24 this is <=d/36.
assumptions: Complex Schmidt-rank unit vectors, not merely real test vectors.
Real Gaussian Hermitian coefficient space, covariance domination in HS norm.
Partial transpose is a self-adjoint HS isometry preserving H0; independence of G and G^Gamma is not assumed.

inputs: Gaussian covariance contraction and rank-k Stiefel/singular-value net counts <=(7/eps)^((4d+1)k).
outputs: Dimension-explicit support bound for both images, usable against the entire convex union base S_k and Gamma S_k.
interface.precision: Exact analytic finite-dimensional tail estimate; numerical low-rank samples are lower bounds on the supremum only.
costs: Dense complex d²-by-d² storage costs16d^4 bytes and diagonalization O(d^6); threshold d>=2^24 is impractical.
Existence proof does not execute giant matrices, enumerate nets or certify a small-d witness.

proof_mechanism: Orthogonally project Gaussian to H0 to retain exact marginals and variance contraction.
Rank-k SVD uses operator-norm Stiefel nets and Euclidean singular values, giving unit-norm centers with no hidden log(k).
Process increments have variance <=2||v-w||²; dyadic net union bounds telescope.
Explicit sums bound the support by40sqrt(r)+8sqrt(u).
Apply the same distributional bound to Gamma G and a union bound, never independence;5*48²*36²=14929920<2^24.
obstructions: Partial transpose and reshuffling are HS isometries, not operator-norm isometries.
No fixed d=4,k=2 certificate or channel-composition obstruction follows.
Different AN PT-invariant covariance/normalization cannot borrow these constants.

potential_uses.target: Other finite collections of fixed HS isometries
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Fix maps before sampling and charge union-bound log cardinality; acquire positivity, trace normalization and separation separately. Adaptive filtering or unlimited families are excluded.

review.source_reported: Source internal derivations/audits and finite checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
